source: sars-guide:PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Rev 1 p. 28 (deemed standard employment: required to work less than 22 hours a week and furnishes a written declaration of no other employer; taxed as standard employment)
notes: Required to work 20 hours a week (4 days of 5 hours, R390 a day, 17 days = R6 630 a month = R79 560 a year) and has furnished the written declaration that he/she will not render services to any other employer: deemed standard employment (G21 p. 28), so the tables apply and the amount is under the R99 000 threshold: nil. The calculator already gives nil; this case guards TS-b against taxing deemed-standard staff at a flat 25% (R1 657.50). The "paid less than R394 per day" limb of the deemed-standard bullet is read as an alternative condition: LOW-MEDIUM confidence on the exact wording.
